title: Goalie-guess veto rerun on the #66 goalie definition (exploratory)
hypothesis: The guess-mode veto of goalie_gsax still holds after #66 gave a one-sided goalie the neutral form: on the validation seasons 2022-23 and 2023-24, the guess-mode log loss of Elo plus goalie_gsax is above the log loss of Elo alone. This is an exploratory rerun on spent seasons. It is not a confirmation, and it does not count as a look.
promotion_criterion: none: an exploration record cannot promote a feature. The veto rule is the one of the original spec: a candidate is vetoed when its guess-mode validation log loss is above the Elo alone by more than 1e-9.
failure_outcome: if the veto flips, change no live feature and file an issue for a confirmation look under #38
